[Intro]
[E5]

[Verse 1]
[E5]Beating
Heart still
beating for the
cause
Feeding
Soul still
feeding on the
loss
Aching
Limbs are
aching from the
rush
Fading
You are
fading from my
sight

[Verse 2]
[G#5]Break of morning,
[G5]coldness lingers
[B5]on
[F5]
[G#5]Shroud me into
[G5]nightmares of the sun
[B5]
[F5]
[E5]

[Verse 3]
[E5]Moving
I am
moving closer to your
side
Luring
You are
luring me into the
night
Crying
Who is
crying for you
here
Dying
I am
dying fast inside your
tears

[Verse 4]
[G#5]Plunging towards
[G5]bereavement faster
[B5]yet
[F5]
[G#5]Clearing thoughts, my
[G5]mind is
[B5]set
[F5]
[E5]

[Chorus]
[Bm]Devious move-
ments in your eyes
Moved
me from relief
Breath comes out white
clouds with your lies
And
filters through me
You're close to the fi-
nal word
You're staring right past
me in dismay
A liquid seeps from
your chest
And drains
me away
Mist ripples round
your thin white neck
And
draws me a line
Cold fingers mark
this dying wreck
This
moment is mine

[Interlude]

[Guitar Solo]

Night falls again
Taking what's left of
[F#m]me Slight twist, [Fm]
[F#m]shivering corpse Or-
[F#m]nated with [Fm]water,
[F#m]fills the cracks
[F#m]Clasped in my [Fm]limbs by
[F#m]tradition
[F#m]This is all [Fm]you
